description: Pomme: Minecraft: Java Edition client written from scratch in Rust and Vulkan. Joins vanilla servers 1.20 to 26.3; singleplayer runs on the built-in SteelMC server.
notes: Needs a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition, and a GPU with Vulkan.
On first start Pomme downloads Minecraft's assets from Mojang into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pomme.
The 'Pomme' shortcut in Scoop Apps starts it with --no-update, so it does not replace itself:
update with 'scoop update Pomme'. Started any other way, Pomme updates its own files in the Scoop folder.
Worlds, profiles, options and the Minecraft assets live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pomme, outside the Scoop folder:
they survive updates, and 'scoop uninstall -p' does not delete them. The sign-in is kept in Windows Credential Manager.
pre_install: # Upstream's Inno Setup installer (per user, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Pomme) updates itself and shares %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pomme with this copy.

error "Pomme $($innoCopy.DisplayVersion) is already installed with upstream's installer ($where). Uninstall it first in Settings > Apps (worlds, profiles and assets in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pomme stay), or run `$env:GESU_ALLOW_EXISTING = '1' and install again to keep both copies. Scoop has already downloaded and unpacked ${app}: run 'scoop uninstall $app' or simply install again, which cleans that up."
warn "Pomme from upstream's installer stays installed too ($where). Both copies use the same data in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Pomme; do not run them at the same time."
